observation: own apparatus active or inactive; no remote observation
primary_objective: whole-world sampled full-configuration path entropy; rate first (ties within1e-9), organized-root offset second; both roots evaluated
diagnostic_entropy_decomposition: winner rate: next body/fuel given full previous state, then next gates given next body/fuel and full previous state; not hidden-state marginal history entropy
root_matching: same matter, total model energy 4, gates, drive, law and policy; different allocation of stored energy
cadence_anchor: quarter of fixture A base dissociation time; common unit across all policies and arms; no claim of unique physical grain
speed_scope: all microscopic attempt rates including controller scale together; primary cadence .25 for speed sweep
